mapper.sql: CASE WHEN r.id IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alert_record v WHERE v.recognition_id=r.id AND v.record_type IN ('SMS_ALERT','BACKLOG') AND v.status IN ('OPEN','CONFIRMED')) THEN 'EFFECTIVE' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alert_record v WHERE v.recognition_id=r.id AND v.record_type IN ('SMS_ALERT','BACKLOG')) THEN 'REVOKED' WHEN r.participated=1 AND r.ood=0 AND r.behavior_code IN ('c1','c2','c3','c4','c5','c6','c7','c8','c9') THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alert_appeal p WHERE p.target_type='RECOGNITION' AND p.target_id=r.id AND p.status='REVOKED') THEN 'REVOKED' ELSE 'EFFECTIVE' END ELSE 'NOT_APPLICABLE' END

CASE WHEN r.names_captured=1 THEN r.plate_no_snapshot ELSE v.plate_no END AS plate_no, CASE WHEN r.names_captured=1 THEN r.driver_name_snapshot ELSE u.name END AS driver_name, CASE WHEN r.names_captured=1 THEN r.fleet_name_snapshot ELSE f.name END AS fleet_name, CASE WHEN r.names_captured=1 THEN 'SNAPSHOT' ELSE 'CURRENT_PROFILE' END AS name_source
FROM recognition_record r LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON v.id=r.vehicle_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=r.driver_id LEFT JOIN fleet f ON f.id=r.fleet_id
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY r.captured_at DESC,r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT recognition_id,id,record_type,behavior_code,status,sms_status FROM alert_record WHERE recognition_id IN AND driver_id=#{owner} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN p.target_type='RECOGNITION' THEN p.target_id ELSE a.recognition_id END AS recognition_id, p.id,p.target_type,p.target_id,p.status,p.decision_reason,p.reviewed_at FROM alert_appeal p LEFT JOIN alert_record a ON p.target_type='ALERT' AND a.id=p.target_id WHERE ((p.target_type='RECOGNITION' AND p.target_id IN ) OR (p.target_type='ALERT' AND a.recognition_id IN )) AND p.driver_id=#{owner} AND p.id=(SELECT MAX(p2.id) FROM alert_appeal p2 WHERE p2.target_type=p.target_type AND p2.target_id=p.target_id) ORDER BY p.id ASC
